import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s): subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
a=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text()); b=json.loads(Path('frozen-before.json').read_text())
assert a['count']==b['count']==179 and not a['mismatches'] and not b['mismatches']
w('REVIEW.md',Path('REVIEW.md').read_text()+'\nFinal integrity check: standalone verify_frozen.py after exited0 with179 bindings checked and zero mismatches; before likewise179/zero. Manifest seals all completed receipt JSONs and both verifier records. The terminal seal runner receipt/output and the manifest itself are named unavoidable self-exclusions. No frozen or author input changed.\n')
r=json.loads(Path('review.json').read_text()); r['342387']['frozen_checks']={'before':{'count':179,'mismatches':[]},'after':{'count':179,'mismatches':[]}}
w('review.json',json.dumps(r,indent=2))
res=json.loads(Path('resource-inventory.json').read_text())
q=Path('inventory_and_validate.receipt.json'); z=json.loads(q.read_text())
res['completed_runner_receipts_at_snapshot'].append({'file':q.name,'exit':z['exit'],'wall_s':z['wall_s'],'sampled_rss_peak_bytes':z['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'samples':z['samples'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':z['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'killed':z['killed']})
res['terminal_receipts_after_snapshot']=['seal_manifest.receipt.json']
res['frozen_after_observed']={'count':179,'mismatches':[],'exit':0}
w('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps(res,indent=2))
w('HANDOFF.md','''# Persisted independent handoff:342387

Ordinary math and frozen v1/literal source fidelity PASS. Witness G=K3,3,H=C6,f=id has gamma in tilde A outside the specified bar A hat B; hat B is trivial. Exact proof, source map, objections and contrary significance assessment: REVIEW.md. All gates and literal statement: review.json, keyed342387.

Final published bar A and Conj3.28 counterpart HOLD under inherited403/all-alternate-delivery prohibition. Prior/novelty qualification HOLD; no matching independent disproof established and no complete earlier-to-target routine-exclusion bridge found. Significance root adjudication HOLD. No Lean or mathematical execution. Dormant brief only; no dispatch, acceptance or credit. Campaign55/60 unchanged.

Read/access/search/resource inventories persisted. One native search call/three queries. One guarded request/two hops; metadata HTML returned instead of requested independent prior PDF; no retry. Initial and final frozen checks each179 bindings/zero mismatches. SHA256SUMS.json covers all existing artifacts and completed receipts, with terminal self-exclusions named. Terminal seal receipt separately records its own exit and measured resource samples.
''')
exclude={'SHA256SUMS.json':'Manifest cannot hash itself','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'Terminal runner creates receipt after this child finishes; cannot include own completed receipt without recursive mutation','seal_manifest.output.txt':'Terminal stdout created by runner after child finishes'}
files={}
for q in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if q.is_file() and str(q.relative_to(p)) not in exclude:
  files[str(q.relative_to(p))]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':q.stat().st_size}
completed=sorted(q.name for q in p.iterdir() if q.is_file() and (q.name.endswith('.receipt.json') or q.name=='bootstrap-receipt.json'))
assert all(n in files for n in completed)
w('SHA256SUMS.json',json.dumps({'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'completed_receipt_JSONs_included':completed,'terminal_self_exclusions':exclude,'frozen_before_after':'179 bindings each; zero mismatches; standalone verifiers','scope':'Own lane files only; original author references hash-only in supplied frozen verifier'},indent=2))
check=json.loads(Path('SHA256SUMS.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v['sha256'] for n,v in check['files'].items())
print(json.dumps({'sealed_files':len(files),'completed_receipts_included':len(completed),'frozen_bindings':179,'mismatches':0,'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('SHA256SUMS.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'review_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('REVIEW.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'verdict':'ORDINARY_V1_PASS_QUALIFICATION_HOLD','credit':0}))
